items.title: Nimitz Trains New, Returning Naval Aviators
items.summary: Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Nimitz (CVN 68) returned to Naval Station Norfolk, completing its first east coast training underway in support of carrier qualifications for both new and experienced naval aviators, Nov. 9.

items.title: USS Abraham Lincoln to shift home port to Bremerton
items.summary: SAN DIEGO -- Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN 72) will shift its home port from San Diego to Bremerton, Washington, later this year to complete a long-planned maintenance availability. items.title: USS Robert Smalls returns to San Diego after a 7-month deployment
items.summary: SAN DIEGO — Ticonderoga-class guided-missile cruiser USS Robert Smalls (CG 62) arrived at its new homeport of Naval Base San Diego, following a 7-month deployment supporting U.S. 7th Fleet operations, including two carrier strike groups in the Pacific, Oct. 9.

items.title: George H.W. Bush Carrier Strike Group Departs Thailand
items.summary: PHUKET, Thailand– Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George H.W. Bush (CVN 77), flagship of Carrier Strike Group (CSG) 10, and embarked staffs and accompanying strike group units departed Thailand following a scheduled October port visit.

items.summary: SAN DIEGO — Abraham Lincoln departed its homeport on Nov. 21, 2025. items.title: George H.W. Bush Carrier Strike Group arrives in Thailand
items.summary: Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George H.W. Bush (CVN 77), flagship of Carrier Strike Group (CSG) 10, and Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Delbert D. Black (DDG 119) arrived in Phuket for a scheduled port visit, Oct. 4, 2026.

items.title: USS Harry S. Truman departs Norfolk, begins move to Newport News for RCOH
items.summary: NORFOLK, Va. — The Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Harry S. Truman (CVN 75) departed Naval Station Norfolk Sept. 30 for Newport News Shipbuilding, beginning the next major phase of the ship’s Refueling and Complex Overhaul.
